response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced and versatile software engineer, but his background is almost entirely in web, mobile, and full-stack development (JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) with no evidence of embedded Linux kernel work, network switch/security technologies, or C-based UNIX systems programming. Critically, the role requires native-level Japanese proficiency, which is not listed among his languages (English, Romanian, German only), making this a hard disqualifier regardless of technical fit.
strengths: Strong, broad engineering experience across many languages and platforms over 15+ years
Demonstrated systems-level programming background (C/C++ at National Instruments, low-latency DLang work)
Experience with Linux and Docker-based infrastructure
concerns: No native or listed Japanese language proficiency, a mandatory requirement
No demonstrated experience with Linux kernel investigation/modification, embedded firmware, or switch chip technologies
No evidence of security-specific domain knowledge (MACsec, 802.1X, tamper detection, encryption/key exchange)

key_factors.factor: No embedded/Linux kernel or network security domain experience
General software craftsmanship and C/C++ background
